15px;\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is an a online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient\/ attender was informed the purpose of the information being acquired. An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHIEF COMPLANITS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 75 year old woman came to the OPD with chief complaints of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- shortness of breath since 10 days.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Dry cough since 5 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 days ago, then \u0026nbsp;she developed shortness of breath that was insidious in onset, aggravated on exposure to cold.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O of orthopnea, wheeze.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDry cough is also present since 10 days aggravated at night.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of chest pain since 10 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo aggravating or relieving factors present.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O \u0026nbsp;paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O fever, chest pain, chest tightness, hemoptysis, sweating, palpitations\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O weight loss.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESimilar complaints 10 years ago. Usage of rotahaler (Fluticasone + vilantrol)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O TB, epilepsy, thyroid disorders, HTN, CAD in the
